Class Waypoint

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.robotics.navigation.Waypoint
public final class Waypoint extends Object
A point a Navigator drives to, in the pose's Cartesian millimetres, optionally with the heading the robot must face there, as leJOS's Waypoint. Unlike leJOS's, the position tolerance is enforced: the navigator drives another leg while the robot ends a leg further than maxPositionErrorMillimetres() from the point. Create the path's waypoints once at startup.
